_comment: Behavior-defining TMDb Helper core settings applied to every device by the setup service. Since TMDb Helper 6.20, Trakt and MDbList live in separate provider add-ons (script.module.tmdbhelper.sync.trakt and .mdblist): their own settings are in trakt_module_settings.json and mdblist_settings.json, and the MDbList API key moved to the latter. Each sync capability must be assigned a provider in sync_provider_<capability>, otherwise the Trakt rows stay empty or prompt a setup dialog: watched and watchlist use Trakt, collection is off ('never'), and scrobbling is 'never' on purpose because Red Light owns Trakt scrobbling (Red Light marks watched on Trakt, see the Red Light Trakt check in service.py); with the Red Light auto player TMDb Helper never learns what is playing anyway, and 'never' also suppresses TMDb Helper's provider setup prompt for that capability. max_threads caps TMDb Helper parallel requests (default 0 is unlimited): its next-episodes sync fires one Trakt call per in-progress show at once, which trips Trakt rate limiting; the resulting silent 15 second cooldown blanks the rest of the batch and TMDb Helper persists that as an empty Up Next for half a day. Removed in 0.8.9: mdblist_apikey (setting no longer exists in core), trakt_scrobbling (replaced by sync_provider_scrobbling), trakt_cacheownlists and nextepisodes_usecalendar (now read from the Trakt module). Removed in 0.9.1: sync_provider_stats (TMDb Helper 6.21.2 dropped the Trakt stats feature and its setting).
